title: Linda W Probable NDE 22558
content: I was loaded into the ambulance! My symptoms where high blood pressure, clammy feeling, nausea, and a feeling of fainting. The tech in the ambulance kept asking me if I had ever had a heart attack as my EEG was not right. He ask me three time and I just left him. I could hear him but did not care as I was no longer in any distress and I was floating just above the gurney. The feeling was incredible as I am a worry type of person. I at this time did not have any worries at all. Actually, everything in my life seem wonderful. I did not feel as though I was going to stay in the ambulance but that I was going to a place that was beautiful. I don't know how to explain this feeling as I have never had a feeling nor have I know anyone who ever expressed ever feeling like this. It was like I was not a person anymore. At least not the same person. Then we arrived at the hospital and they started doing test on me.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Uncertain Illness, trauma or other condition not considered life threatening. Blood Pressure very high. They kept asking me if I had ever had a heart attack. I kept telling them no! This month after a stress test I indeed did have one but we don't know when I had it.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Uncertain Well I knew that I was not feeling well in my body, but my mind was more than well. It was in this beautiful place.
elements.At what time during the experience were: I was totally awake the entire time. One hundred percent consciousness and alertness.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I felt as if time was standing still or going very slow.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: The only noise I heard is the ambulance tech talking to me. If, I answered him, I was not aware of it. However, I was awake!
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm All of my senses were working overtime!
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: You cannot explain the emotion as unless you have had this emotion it is unexplainable.
elements.Did you suddenly seem to understand ever: Everything about the universe I came to know that we don't die! We move on to a wonderful place where there is not pain or sorrow. That there is more than five or six senses; we have many more that we have not experienced.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I was still in the ambulance but I could smell flowers and felt like I was going to lay down on the ground covered in flowers.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes I absolutely know there is a place called Heaven.
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: because of your experience? Yes I absolutely know there is a place called Heaven. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes I absolutely know there is a place called Heaven. Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes The feeling was wonderful. I was not sick anymore and everything around me was wonderful. It was like nothing but wonderful things were ever going to happen to me from that point forward. I did not feel as though I was lying down but floating just off the gurney. Nothing could hurt me!
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Yes I have always had a gift but I have never experienced anything like this before. The gifts I have is when a person is going to pass, I dream it prior to it happening.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The worst is not staying in that place. The best is being there for the time I had.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes My husband. He knows I have gifts and he also had a similar event.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: Only that you would really like to have the experience. It's incredible.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Uncertain I think I have done my best. But it is truly hard to explain.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: I think you covered it. Except these are not all out of body experiences. They are experience that even being out of body a bit cannot truly explain.
